program='''def transform(grid):
    bg = 8
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    split = (r0 + r1) // 2
    colors = {grid[r][c] for r, c in cells}
    a, b = sorted(colors)
    swap = {a: b, b: a}
    middle_cells = [c for rr, c in cells if rr == split]
    width = max(middle_cells) - min(middle_cells) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        if r <= split:
            out[r][c] = bg
    for r, c in cells:
        if r <= split:
            out[r][c + width] = swap[grid[r][c]]
        else:
            out[r][c] = swap[grid[r][c]]
    return out
'''
